commands.environment: TEMP and TMP point to target/qianxing-test-temp

coverage: OrderGroupState durably stores a pending amendment overlay, keeps the group behind ReconcileRequired, confirms venue terms, and safely aborts only when the original terms remain authoritative.
Only a reconciled triggered native OCO child on the supported OKX/Bitget CCXT route is eligible; quantity and limit terms may change while conditional trigger terms remain fixed.
Account EventLog recovery keeps unresolved amendments fenced, commits confirmed OMS terms, or releases an overlay only when no pending amendment fact exists and prior terms are unchanged.
Order lifecycle transitions and monotonic fill facts are checked before committing an amendment snapshot.
CCXT request construction preserves a conditional sidecar and rejects trigger-term changes.
scope_limitations: This implementation covers triggered native OCO child quantity/limit amendments for the CCXT OKX and Bitget path; it does not implement Bracket group amendments or changing trigger terms.
This is local Windows Rust test evidence only. No private exchange API was called and no order was changed.
OKX and Bitget sandbox lifecycle acceptance and Binance native OCO group amendment are not established by this evidence.
